dossier.identity: reconnaissance operator who sends her ravens ahead, reveals the whole lane and calls a roost over whoever is still standing~
dossier.selectionRationale: operator because the signal rifle works through information and support: scouting ravens that reveal and mark, a healing roost and a perched raven that watches for her. distinct from echo's tempo and fable's healing by owning reveal and marked-target play. the companion rule (owner decision F5) gives corva a raven: raven_flight for the scouting route and raven_perched for the watching companion. hypothesis kit (owner decision 2026-11-07).
dossier.weaponConcept: signal rifle (long-range tactical rifle for reconnaissance and coordinated strikes, with a variable-zoom target-analysis optic, a drone-band transmitter for raven sync, a lightweight modular receiver, a lilac rail telemetry link and a feather-motif chassis)

lore.backstory: a lighthouse signal-keeper from the northern break-water who trained a flock of ravens to carry messages through jammed skies. when the lighthouse was sold for scrap she kept the flock and the rifle that talks to it, and now relays the news of every fight to whoever needs to see it coming~
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for jamming a syndicate surveillance grid with fourteen ravens and for refusing to name the flock to a corporate auditor.
lore.psychProfile: quiet, observant and warm in a watchful way; trusts anything that sees more than she does, and shares everything she sees.
lore.combatQuote: “more eyes see a kinder tomorrow, darling. let my flock look around and then walk where it tells you.”

counterplay: Shoot the raven down (it is a shootable carrier), sidestep the route, or cleanse the mark.

forms.name: raven route
forms.description: Sends one raven 9 m (900 cm) along a route (14 m/s, 0.8 m wide): enemies it passes are revealed through cover for 4 s (120 ticks) and take 40 damage. The raven is a shootable carrier of 60 hp. Cost 14 · windup 0.3 s (9 ticks) · cooldown 8 s (240 ticks).

forms.name: scouting pair
forms.description: Two ravens fly two routes 20 degrees apart; each deals 75% damage and reveals as the first does.

forms.name: scouting fan
forms.description: Five ravens fly a 60 degree fan, each dealing 40% damage; an enemy passed by two or more ravens is also marked for 3 s (90 ticks).

signature.stock: Calls a night shelter up to 9 m (900 cm) away: radius 3 m (300 cm), lasting 5 s (150 ticks) and pulsing every 1 s (30 ticks) for 45 healing to allies inside, who also take 15% less damage. Cost 38 · windup 0.73 s (22 ticks) · cooldown 20 s (600 ticks).
signature.interpretation: Numbers are authored hypotheses proposed from the concept sheet and the roster conventions (owner decision 2026-11-07, characters#31); form descriptions specify behavior. Geometry is the authored illustration profile, not an executable collision bake.

forms.name: swift shelter

forms.name: twin roosts
forms.description: A second 3 m (300 cm) roost opens within 6 m (600 cm) of the first with the same pulses and haste.

iconFamily.subject: a bold raven in flight above a single chunky signal arc
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Corva. Theme: raven relay. Subject: a bold raven in flight above a single chunky signal arc. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
